answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Herbalist watered root record witnessed at the orchard warrant is the proof, and the price is 7-year garden service, 78 supervised plantings, graft exam, annual tally dues. The price of one fake is 113 POA and 13 minutes; the price of 554 fakes is 62602 POA and 7202 minutes. The juniper names the issuer, the horizon names the price, and the atlas names the date: a forger must forge all three. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
